# Good First Issue: [Task Title]

## What you'll need to know
- **Technologies involved**: List the main tech stack (e.g., React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS)
- **Estimated time to complete**: ~1-2 hours (always keep this small for good first issues)
- **Difficulty level**: Beginner-friendly - no deep project knowledge required

## Description
Clear, step-by-step description of what needs to be done. Be specific so a new contributor can understand the task without asking too many questions.

Example:
"Update the login form to add password visibility toggle:
1. Add an eye icon to the right side of the password input
2. When clicked, toggle the input type between 'password' and 'text'
3. Ensure the icon updates to reflect the current state (eye when hidden, eye-off when visible)
4. Make sure this works on both mobile and desktop"

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The feature works as expected in all supported browsers
- [ ] All existing tests pass
- [ ] Code follows the project's style guide (ESLint + Prettier)
- [ ] No new console errors or warnings are introduced
- [ ] The UI matches the existing design system

## Resources to Help You Get Started
- Link to the relevant component file(s)
- Link to the project's design system or style guide
- Any documentation that might help
- Example of similar code in the codebase

If you're new to open source or this project, don't hesitate to ask questions in the comments! We're here to help you succeed. 🎉
